component.name: steam-cli
component.summary: Steam Web API, Workshop, SteamCMD and ArchiSteamFarm from the terminal

description.p: A single static binary for working with Steam from the command line: Web API discovery and calls, Workshop search and collection management, service status, SteamCMD bootstrap and downloads, ArchiSteamFarm IPC, local library inspection, and forwarding to the desktop Steam client.
No telemetry, no hosted middleware, no browser automation, and no runtime dependencies.
